item.title: Celtic sack manager
item.description: Celtic have sacked manager Wilfried Nancy after just 8 games in charge. He lost six of those matches, with the run including defeats in the Scottish League Cup final to St Mirren and to Rangers in the Old Firm derby at the weekend. His three assistants will also leave the club, while Head of Football Operations Paul Tisdale has also been sacked. Advertisement There's yet to be an announcement on who will take over.

item.title: Idah facing a race to be to fit for World Cup play-off
item.description: Adam Idah is facing a race to be to fit for the Republic of Ireland's World Cup play-off against Czechia in March. Swansea have confirmed the striker could be out for up to three months with a hamstring injury. Idah has been sidelined since suffering the issue in training two weeks ago. Advertisement

item.title: Henshaw back for Leinster
item.description: Robbie Henshaw is back for Leinster's Investec Champions Cup clash with La Rochelle on Saturday. The Ireland centre had been sidelined since injuring his finger in the URC champions' win at Munster last month. Garry Ringrose and RG Snyman are also back training with the province, while a decision will be made on Harry Byrne and Rabah Slimani's availability later in the week. Advertisement

item.title: Kerry parents and e-scooter users urged to review rules around e-scooters
item.description: Parents and e-scooter users in Kerry are being reminded people to exercise caution on the vehicle. Regional Chief Superintendent for the Southern Garda Region, Colm O’Sullivan made the plea. Chief Superintendent O’Sullivan says there has been a number of serious incidents involving e-scooters recorded in Kerry and nationwide, over the past few years. item.title: Tourism prospects for Kerry from international market looking very strong this year
item.description: The tourism prospects for Kerry from the international market are looking very strong this year. That’s according to Patrick O’Donoghue, who is the chair of the Kerry Tourism Industry Federation marketing sub-committee. He says last year was a successful one from a tourism perspective, with many visitors travelling from the US. item.title: Priority routes throughout Kerry to be treated twice overnight as freezing temperatures continue
item.description: Kerry County Council says priority routes will be treated twice overnight as freezing temperatures continue. Temperatures are expected to fall as low as -3 in parts of the county tonight, and this will result in treacherous travelling conditions. Kerry County Council is warning that there’ll be icy conditions on all routes tonight and tomorrow morning. item.title: Littler to headline Premier League line up
item.description: World champion Luke Littler will headline a new eight-player line-up for this year's Premier League Darts. The teenager, who recently secured back-to-back world titles, will be joined by the man he beat in Saturday's final, Gian van Veen and fellow debutant Josh Rock. Luke Humphries, Michael van Gerwen, Jonny Clayton, Stephen Bunting and Gerwyn Price complete the selection for the weekly tournament. Advertisement
